item.title: CHP begins extra New Year’s holiday DUI patrols at 6 p.m. Wednesday
item.description: The California Highway Patrol will add patrols statewide for the New Year's holiday beginning at 6 p.m. Wednesday and continuing until 11:59 p.m. Thursday.

item.title: Husband suspected of ramming truck into Clairemont home, killing wife
item.description: "Numerous neighbors reported... a vehicle driving into a house... When officers got there, they found a woman who was deceased."

item.title: Beloved local musician killed in motorcycle crash near Balboa Park
item.description: A beloved local musician was killed early Sunday when the motorcycle he was riding collided with an SUV near Balboa Park.

item.title: San Diego County names new department leaders, more hires ahead
item.description: San Diego County announced Monday that several departments will have new heads in the new year, while others are hiring for leadership positions. item.title: La Jolla Village News: Dec. 19, 2025
item.description: This issue of La Jolla Village News highlights holiday celebrations across the community, City Council debates over police surveillance technology, opposition to offshore drilling, local sports achievements, new restaurant and retail openings, cultural events, and neighborhood traditions—from the Christmas Parade to seasonal arts, dining, and civic life.

item.title: La Mesa Courier: Dec. 19, 2025
item.description: This issue of La Mesa Courier features local holiday celebrations, public safety updates, community concerns along University Avenue, crime trends, school programs, housing and planning developments tied to SDSU growth, local culture, events, and East County wine highlights, alongside community voices and seasonal reflections.

item.title: SD inmate accused of multiple in-custody knife attacks pleads not guilty
item.description: A man already facing charges for allegedly trying to stab a San Diego County sheriff's deputy pleaded not guilty Monday to new charges related to a separate alleged knife attack on a jail deputy.

item.title: New statewide animal protection, vet care laws to take effect Jan. 1
item.description: Five animal welfare laws aimed at protecting pets while strengthening veterinary care statewide will take effect Jan. 1, San Diego Humane Society announced Monday.

item.title: San Diego County to ring in new year with rain, chance of mountain snow
item.description: San Diego County is in for a wild weather week, continuing with warm, gusty Santa Ana winds and ending with rain and mountain snow as the new year rolls in.

item.title: 2025 was one of three hottest years on record, scientists say
item.description: Climate change worsened by human behavior made 2025 one of the three hottest years on record, scientists said.
